terra.problem: “The lifting comes later” promises that the people are lifted high, but the psalm does not say that.
The verse says the banner is raised so they may flee the bow. It does not say arrows are coming or that the banner points them out of the way.
“No nap, just triumph” makes a joke about God, whose words are being discussed.
Calling wages a funny thing to ask God for makes the imagined request to God the joke.
“Heaven” and “man” are not close in sound. What Papa points out must be true.
